New Football Club \"Volos\", also known as Volos Elabet for sponsorship reasons, is a Greek professional football club based in Volos, Magnesia, Greece. The club currently competes in the Super League, the first tier of football in Greece. Volos plays its home matches at the Panthessaliko Stadium.
